description: Land Title Settlement Department - Balagalla, Divulapitiya D/S Division, Gampaha District - Cad. Map No. 510006
categorisation: This gazette content deals exclusively with land title registration matters under the Registration of Title Act, No. 21 of 1998. It contains declarations of determination for specific land parcels (Parcel Nos. 82, 83, 255, 277, and 81) with detailed information about land ownership, extent, location, and encumbrances. The content falls under "Land registrations, property ownership, land titles" as specified in the Land Gazettes (Type 4) category, and appears in "PART III - LANDS" of the gazette.
